ingredients.raw: 3 to 4 cloves garlic, peeled, crushed and chopped (2 teaspoons)
½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper

steps.text: Put the garlic in a large salad bowl and mix in all the remaining ingredients except the cabbage.

Trim the cabbage, removing and discarding damaged or wilted leaves, and cut the head crosswise into 1-inch slices. You should have about 8 cups. Wash well and spin dry in a salad dryer (moisture would dilute the dressing). Ten or 15 minutes before serving, add the cabbage to the dressing, toss well and set aside, so the dressing can penetrate the cabbage and soften it slightly.

name: Nasi Goreng (Indonesian Fried Rice With Vegetables)
author: Craig Claiborne, Pierre Franey

ingredients.raw: 5 cups cold, cooked rice (preferably cooked a day in advance)
ingredients.preparation: cooked rice (preferably cooked a day in advance)

ingredients.raw: ¼ pound long Chinese green beans, available in Oriental markets, cut into 3-inch lengths, or use regular green beans, stringed as necessary and cut into 3-inch lengths
ingredients.preparation: available in Oriental markets, cut into 3-inch lengths, or use regular green beans, stringed as necessary and cut into 3-inch lengths

ingredients.raw: 3 tablespoons corn, peanut or vegetable oil
1 cup celery cut on the diagonal into thin slices
ingredients.item: celery cut on the diagonal into thin slices

ingredients.raw: 1 ½ cups carrot cut into thin, julienne strips, each about 2 inches long
ingredients.preparation: julienne strips, each about 2 inches long

ingredients.raw: 1 cup broccoli cut or broken into small, bite-size pieces
ingredients.item: broccoli cut or broken into small

ingredients.raw: 2 cups finely shredded bok choy or Chinese cabbage
ingredients.item: finely shredded bok choy or chinese cabbage

ingredients.raw: 1 cup snow peas cut lengthwise into thin, julienne strips
ingredients.item: snow peas cut lengthwise into thin

ingredients.raw: ⅓ cup shredded scallions or green onions cut into 2-inch lengths
ingredients.item: shredded scallions or green onions cut into 2-inch lengths

ingredients.raw: 3 tablespoons hot green or red pepper, cored and seeded and cut into very thin, julienne strips
ingredients.preparation: cored and seeded and cut into very thin, julienne strips

ingredients.raw: 3 tablespoons ketjap manis, a sweet Indonesian soy sauce, or use an equal amount of soy sauce blended with 3 tablespoons sugar
ingredients.preparation: a sweet Indonesian soy sauce, or use an equal amount of soy sauce blended with 3 tablespoons sugar

ingredients.raw: ½ cup finely chopped scallions or green onions
ingredients.item: finely chopped scallions or green onions

steps.text: Prepare the rice as indicated and have it ready.
In a kettle, bring enough water to the boil to cover the green beans when they are added. Add salt to taste. Add the beans and cook about two minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat the oil in a wok or skillet until it is almost smoking. Add the celery and carrot and cook, stirring, about 45 seconds.

Add the broccoli and the drained long beans and cook about 15 seconds, stirring. Add the bok choy and snow peas and cook about 30 seconds, stirring. Add the scallions or green onions and the pepper. Cook 10 seconds.
Add the rice, stirring rapidly, and cook until thoroughly heated without browning.

Do the following as quickly as possible: Make a well in the center of the rice and add the eggs, stirring rapidly and constantly. When they are barely scrambled, start stirring the rice into the eggs, stirring in a circular fashion, incorporating all of the rice.
Sprinkle with ketjap manis and salt, add the bean sprouts and cook, stirring and tossing, about 30 seconds. Sprinkle with the chopped scallions and serve immediately.

ingredients.raw: 4 tablespoons white wine vinegar (or a fruit vinegar if available)
ingredients.item: white wine vinegar (or a fruit vinegar if available)

steps.text: In salad bowl, put ruby lettuce on bottom, then arugula and finally nasturtium blossoms, carefully arranged to set off the color of the flowers.
With whisk, whip together all ingredients for vinaigrette. There should be about 6 ounces.
Dress salad with half the vinaigrette.

name: Navy Bean And Celery Root Soup
author: Moira Hodgson

ingredients.raw: 1 celery root (about one-half pound) peeled and cut into quarter-inch dice
ingredients.item: celery root (about one-half pound) peeled and cut into quarter-inch dice

ingredients.raw: Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
ingredients.item: coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

ingredients.raw: 4 teaspoons white distilled vinegar or lemon juice, or to taste
ingredients.item: white distilled vinegar or lemon juice

steps.text: Put the beans and four cups water in a pot and bring to boil. Cover, turn heat to low and simmer for two minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the pot sit, covered, for one hour. Bring the contents of the pot to boil again. Cover, turn heat to low and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the celery root, tomatoes, onion, garlic and parsley.
Crush the rosemary and thyme together and add along with one cup water. Bring to a boil. Cover, turn heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Uncover and add the salt, some black pepper, the vinegar or lemon juice, as well as the oil.

Cook, uncovered, on low heat, for another 15 minutes, stirring the soup every now and again, and also mashing some of it against the side of the pot with the back of a large spoon. If the soup seems too thick, thin it out with some water.
